page.overview:
What is Grymmdjarr Monument?

Grymmdjarr Monument is a large inukshuk on the isle of Ard Skellig consecrated to half-godlike human hero known as Grymmdjarr.

This is also the location of the small side quest Brave Fools Die Young, where you can choose to help out Petter or not. Afterwards the monument will have a group of warriors around it.
